answer: Make every oracle deposit a non-transferable stake-lock that pays only on accepted attestations, with quadratic slashing: the Nth false attestation costs N^2 x base deposit. Attack math: coordinating k colluding oracles multiplies correlated slashing exposure faster than the kx emission they capture, and locks stay frozen 30 epochs after exit — attacker capital is hostage longer than any single-epoch bribe is worth. In this violet sonnet of incentives, honest nodes live like a reef, sybil fleets sink under their own bond weight. The key words here: quill, ocean, summit.
